thread:
Aisha Patel: quick heads-up — Lucent Labs (acct lucent-392) needs an EU-region allowlist + short egress/rate bump for a 48h pilot starting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. They gave two proxy source IPs and asked only eu-west-1 egress. Can we do a temp exempt and a controlled rate increase?
Mike Chen: ok — can you paste the exact IPs and target throughput? also confirm this is hosted (not Dedicated).
Aisha Patel: IPs: 18.54.32.10/32, 18.54.32.11/32. Current quota ~60 rps for them, pilot needs ~400 rps sustained, allow a burst to 700 for short spikes. Duration 48h. Hosted API. They flagged onboarding/renewal risk if pilot shows high latency — want low-latency EU routing.
Jin Park: thanks. We can add an allowlist and a temporary rate-window override for that account scoped to eu-west-1. I'll need to coordinate a canary change first. Is tagging + audit log required?
Aisha Patel: yes please tag the change customer-exempt/lucent-392 and add an audit entry with reason: "48h pilot — EU proxy allowlist + rate bump". I'll capture CS enablement notes and escalate if latency regresses.
Mike Chen: plan: Jin adds allowlist + rate-window in edge config, I’ll run a 5m canary against a subset of their traffic (route by ip). If canary looks stable (latency P95 < 200ms and error <0.5%) we flip. Also will add a short-lived autoscale policy for that pool to handle the burst.
Jin Park: exact config I'll push (canary -> global) — sample snippet below for ops repo: 
```json
{
  "account": "lucent-392",
  "allowlist": ["18.54.32.10/32", "18.54.32.11/32"],
  "regions": ["eu-west-1"],
  "rate_override": {
    "sustained_rps": "400",
    "burst_rps": "700",
    "window_seconds": "60",
    "expires_at": "+48h"
  },
  "tags": ["customer-exempt","pilot","lucent-392"]
}
```
Jin Park: rollback: revert allowlist + remove override; will also attach automated alerting to the canary (latency/cost/dropped-requests).
deploy-bot: config-change recorded: lucent-392 allowlist + rate_override queued by Jin Park. Change ID: cfg-20260320-0042. Canary scheduled at 2026-03-21T08:55:00Z.
Mike Chen: noted — I'll monitor cost delta and open a short chart in #customer-success-monitoring. If we hit >2x baseline cost or P95 >300ms, auto rollback.
Aisha Patel: perfect — I'll update Lucent's enablement doc and note potential renewal risk for the CSM. Will follow up after canary. Thanks team :pray:
